title: Charred Lamb Cacio e Pepe
description: A creative twist on the Italian classic, featuring charred lamb and a rich cacio e pepe sauce.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: bone-in, preferably with a good layer of fat

ingredients.name: italian seasonings
ingredients.notes: dried herbs like thyme, rosemary, and oregano

instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Season the lamb with Italian seasonings.
Grill the lamb for 2-3 minutes per side, or until nicely charred. Transfer to a plate and let rest.
Cook the cacio e pepe cheese according to package instructions. Typically involves melting the cheese in a saucepan over low heat.
Slice the grilled lamb into thin strips.
To assemble the dish, place a few slices of lamb onto a slice of Italian bread.
Top with a spoonful of cacio e pepe cheese, followed by a sprinkle of black pepper.
